major_cooldowns.name: Frozen Orb
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Think about lining it up with a cleave window or an upcoming boss move before you press it, since it deals AoE damage for 15 seconds and tracking a moved target takes a few seconds to catch up.

major_cooldowns.name: Ray of Frost
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Save it for last in your priority list so it consumes as many Freezing stacks as possible before you channel it, then let the channel run its full 4 seconds.

defensives.name: Ice Barrier
defensives.usage_rule: Shield up before a known burst of damage; it absorbs hits for a full minute so you can pre-cast it ahead of a dangerous phase.

defensives.name: Ice Cold
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for a hit you cannot otherwise survive, since it is on a very long cooldown and only lasts 6 seconds.

rules.description: Frostbolt into Flurry, Frozen Orb, Ray of Frost
rules.action: Pre-cast Frostbolt, then open with Flurry, Frozen Orb, Ray of Frost, and Ice Lance in that order.

rules.description: Ice Lance on Fingers of Frost procs
rules.action: Cast Ice Lance as soon as Fingers of Frost procs so the Shatter bonus is not wasted.
Cast Flurry as soon as Brain Freeze procs to keep resetting its cooldown.

rules.description: Blizzard only with a full pack up
rules.action: Only weave Blizzard in once you are fighting 5 or more enemies; below that it loses to continuing to generate Splinters.
